_about: Data for ND Character Builder: parts, parameters, options and the words they turn into. Read by nd_nodes/character_builder.py (text) and js/character_builder.js (UI). Option fields: label (UI), tag (tags format: Danbooru tags; {n} and {m} are replaced by the parameter's n and m, {female:...|male:...} picks by sex; an empty tag falls back to a plain tag: ptag if given, else built from the natural-language words), adj (adjective used in a natural-language group), text (a whole phrase, used when the group has one parameter), post (a phrase placed after the noun), swatch (color), only (sexes the option suits; random skips it for others), weight (how often random picks the option, 1 by default), needs (random picks the option only when another parameter has one of these values, e.g. green skin only for orcs and goblins), word / noun / trait (race: a word before the noun, a noun that replaces it, features added after it), hint (tooltip text), shape (figure only: how the option changes the silhouette), solo (this option replaces the whole group phrase, e.g. 'a flat chest'), mutes (parameters of the same part this option switches off). Parameter fields: multi (up to this many options can be picked at once, e.g. mixed races), only (the parameter is used only for these sexes; it is hidden and left out of the text for the others), hint, set (use a shared option set), n (noun for {n}). Zone fields: copy (a button that copies values between parameters), presets (quick buttons that set several values). More parameter fields: requires (the parameter is used only when another one has one of these values, e.g. penis size only with a penis), random_sets (what random picks for a multi parameter, with only/weight), combos (extra tags and a lead phrase for a combination, e.g. futanari). Option fields: exclusive (in a multi parameter it excludes the others), neg (tag for the Negative output when the option is not chosen). Output field negative: the Negative text. Version 2 additions. Parameter fields: parent (the parameter is drawn inside the row of this one, e.g. the second hair color under the coloring), requires.set (used when the other parameter has any value), shade {level, tint} (a color parameter takes the chosen shade and tone parameters into its adjective), skip (probability that random leaves the parameter unset), type "list" (tattoos: places, designs, styles, sizes, colors, max). Option fields: attrs (race features {id, label, text, tag, only}; the user can switch each off), adj_from (take the adjective of another parameter, e.g. a beard like the hair), silent (an option that adds no words), drop_pre (parameters left out of the adjectives while this option is chosen), mutes may name a parameter of another part as "part.param". post may be a list of fallback phrases: the first that can be filled is used. Tokens {part.param:adj|tag|label|default} in post and tag are replaced by the chosen option of that parameter; without a default a missing value drops the whole phrase. Tattoo places: on ({pos} and {side} are replaced), paired, both, cover (outfit cover names that hide the place), adult (used only while Genitals is on); designs: text ({a} takes size, color and style words), tag, adult. Top level covers: the names an outfit may cover and the parameters hidden by each ("part.*" hides a whole part). An option of a group with a noun field replaces the group noun (e.g. "horse cock" instead of "penis"). Edit mode (instructions for image-editing models): parameter field edit {ops, add, replace, remove, replace_prefix, structural} marks a feature that can be added, replaced or removed (templates use {pos} her/his/their, {obj} her/him/them, {phrase} the text of its group and the usual {part.param:adj|tag|label|text|default} tokens); option fields edit_add / edit_replace / edit_remove override the template for that option; group field edit {feature: param} makes the whole group one feature; structural keeps the parameter in the attribute sentences (genitals.parts decides which groups apply). Parameters without edit are always changed ("Change her eyes to ...").

params.label: Race
params.hint: Human or a fantasy race. Pick up to three to mix them (e.g. elf + fox-folk). Combines with Appearance (the real-world look) and Skin tone.

options.label: Human
options.hint: An ordinary human. The default when nothing is set. Random picks Human about as often as all fantasy races together.

options.hint: Tall, slender and graceful, with long pointed ears.
